package idp

type IdentityProviderUserInfo struct {
	Identifier  string
	DisplayName string
	Email       string
	AvatarURL   string
}

message.text: I should explore the oauth2 directory more thoroughly and also look for other authentication implementations like LDAP or OIDC that might be separate from oauth2.
Confirmed: only one implementation subpackage exists.

h03.

**Abstraction package**: `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go`) — defines the common `IdentityProviderUserInfo` type that concrete providers return.

**Implementation package**: `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`) — the sole shipped concrete implementation, an OAuth2 identity provider (`IdentityProvider` struct with `ExchangeToken`/user-info retrieval), as declared by its package doc: "Package oauth2 implements the OAuth2 identity provider integration."
